name: Trooper Torso
units: points in x12 PNG pixels, top-left origin; points_native in art px
notes: The torso the game draws for every trooper (trooper sheet frame 15). The legs are separate pieces (A03 thigh, A04 shin) that swing from the Hip point in code. Same 41x58 frame and feet row as the other trooper sprites. Ready + push packs it into the trooper sheet; the Hip point moves where the legs attach.
